question: Does OnlineOrNot or PostHog ask for a phone number, or a card, at a step after the visible sign-up form (inside the account, before the free-plan limit applies)?
why: the first-party sign-up and getting-started pages re-read 2026-11-19 ask for an email (with social sign-in) and no phone or card field, so needs_card and needs_phone derive 0 with identity_basis stated; any phone or card step that appears only after registration is unverified: behind a sign-up and cannot be observed without creating an account
